note: Issues and risks identified while building Genome v1, with the software mitigations in place and who owns them. A working register for later independent review; it is not a risk-management file under any standard, and listing a mitigation does not mean the risk is acceptable. No named owner has been recorded; 'project owner' stands until one is.

risks.issue: Reference data, model output or a status label is read as clinical guidance for a person.
risks.mitigation: Not-for-clinical statement on every Vision screen and export; status panel; evidence kinds labelled; clinical mode gated.

risks.issue: Content from a source whose terms are unresolved is shown, stored or redistributed.
risks.mitigation: Per-action source policy, fail closed; raw responses not served; ClinVar withheld everywhere; snapshot workflow manual-only.
risks.residual: Earlier commits still contain the removed ClinVar batches and the previously served raw responses; whether that history needs action is a legal question. Serving even the display copy is pending confirmation of each provider's terms.

risks.issue: The hypothetical gene-therapy model is read as a prediction for a patient.
risks.mitigation: Labelled hypothetical on every view; parameters stated as illustrative and unfitted; no genotype input; compared with the trial only on direction and timing.

risks.issue: The proposed IRD gene list is treated as an authoritative or diagnostically complete panel.
risks.mitigation: Panel stays proposed and non-authoritative while D5 is unresolved; loaders refuse an approved panel with an unresolved decision; the list is recorded in the spec only.

risks.issue: Input on another reference build, or a malformed file, is accepted silently.
risks.mitigation: GRCh38-only header gate with explicit rejections; no liftover or conversion.

risks.issue: Identifiable information (sample names, patient data) is returned, logged or stored.
risks.mitigation: Sample names counted, never returned; no upload on Genome and Vision pages; manifests hold public reference metadata only.

risks.issue: Clinical mode or clinical claims are enabled by a configuration change.
risks.mitigation: Availability is computed from verified evidence and recorded approvals, not from a toggle.
risks.residual: A change that fabricates approval records would pass the software check; it relies on code review. Requiring the project owner's review for config/genome/ (for example in .github/CODEOWNERS) is proposed, not done.

risks.issue: A source changes after capture, so shown values differ from the current database.
risks.mitigation: Every value shows its release and retrieval time; a live check compares with the current sources.

risks.issue: The served display copy drifts from the raw snapshot or from what the app reads.
risks.mitigation: Display copy rebuilt deterministically; tests check it is current and holds exactly the fields the parsers read.
